prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1024; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from behind-side while turning left. Complaints centered on low back pain with muscle spasm and restricted lumbar range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of impact and the pattern of symptoms described at intake. Examination revealed paraspinal tenderness and reduced flexion, while neurological screening and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the lumbar region is known to this provider. Care consisted of 25 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced over time as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service date without duplication. At discharge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was released to independent home exercise with follow-up as needed.
